story:
Every child of Dellingstad is taught the crossbow, Kolfinna the miner wrote to her daughter, and every child is taught it in Zargin's yard. The weaponmaster keeps it at the edge of the town, a square of trodden ash with golems of straw and clay standing in it for the young ones to strike, and he has kept it for longer than most of the town's fortifiers have been alive.

He is not of the town by birth, the soothsayers say, which is why he has no place in its councils and wants none. He came over the rim as a young man, from somewhere the town does not discuss, with a blade and a crossbow and no people, and asked to be let in. Dellingstad lets no stranger in until he has proved a friend, and Zargin proved it, the story goes, by standing in front of the gate for a season and shooting every morvalt that came over the south-western wall, until the fortifiers grew tired of watching him do their work and opened the gate. They never made him one of the town's own. They gave him the children instead.

He teaches them the way the town fights: from the wall, at range, without hurry, and never by letting a stranger close. The students in his yard are the town's young, and they are quick to come at anyone who walks in among them, because that is the first thing he teaches. Zargin himself comes at strangers the same way he came at the morvalt, alone, because he has never had anyone of his own to call and has never asked the town for help. The students come anyway. The soothsayers say that is the only proof the weaponmaster has ever needed that the town took him in after all.

The golems of straw and clay in his yard are struck so often that the miners of the south-west wall make him new ones every month. Kolfinna wrote that her daughter's first golem is still standing in the yard, with one bolt in the middle of its chest, because Zargin will not let it be replaced. He says a teacher should remember what a good shot looks like.
legend: Weaponmaster Zargin is a level 54 Dellingstad NPC in his training yard at the edge of town, with five Zargin's students (45-49) and five dummy golems around him. Like the rest of Dellingstad he's aggressive to you until your People of Dellingstad faction is good. Zargin has no faction himself (no bring-a-friend), but his students do and they're aggressive and right there, and the town's crossbowmen and fortifiers aren't far. No abilities, not CC-immune. Killing Dellingstad folk shifts your faction the usual way, so if you want the town's quests (Mammoth Hunt's whisker goes to Vorkald here), leave the yard alone.

loremasterTopic.text: The stranger who stood a season at [Dellingstad]'s gate shooting morvalt until the town let him in, and was given its children to teach instead of a seat in its councils.

bookPage: From The Bowl and the Rim, by Kolfinna of Dellingstad: when you were small, daughter, Zargin put a crossbow in your hands that was taller than you, and stood behind you, and did not touch it. You shot the golem in the chest on your first bolt. He looked at it a long time and then said to me, not to you, that the town should be glad it let him in, because otherwise you would have had to find out how good you were by shooting at him. I did not know whether he was joking. I still do not.
